policy: Grade all actually requested material parts strictly. Material omission partial, contradiction incorrect. Accept semantic equivalents, do not require unasked background or borrow other answers. Same-response evidence can supply an omitted fact only by stating it; a bare section citation supplies no fact. No proposed grade.

question.question: State Accept Contract and Dutiful Service’s Agent icons and effects with and without CHOAM, and whether both automatically advance a Faction track.

key.expected_answer: Accept Contract: Spice Trade, draw card plus contract or 2 Solari, no automatic Faction Influence. Dutiful Service: Emperor, one Emperor Influence plus contract or 2 Solari. Contract fallback if module off or all contracts taken.

response.answer: Accept Contract uses the Spice Trade icon; without CHOAM it draws a card and gives 2 Solari, and with CHOAM it lets you take a contract and replace it. Dutiful Service uses the Emperor icon; it gives 1 Emperor Influence and takes a contract with CHOAM, or gives 2 Solari without CHOAM. Neither effect itself says to advance an additional Faction track beyond Dutiful Service's stated Emperor Influence; Accept Contract grants no automatic Influence.
response.evidence: Board Space Guide: Accept Contract (Spice Trade) and Dutiful Service (Emperor) entries; intro says non-Faction/Landsraad spaces give no automatic Influence.
